findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: estimate_audit, get_loop, preview_upload · Private data: audit_source, scan_source, estimate_audit, verify_fix, list_modules, mint_key, run_module, judge_output, dispute_finding, report_loop, preview_upload · Public sink: audit_source, scan_source, judge_output, report_loop, preview_upload · Destructive: estimate_audit, list_modules, run_module, judge_output.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: estimate_audit, get_loop, preview_upload · Private data: audit_source, scan_source, estimate_audit, verify_fix, list_modules, mint_key, run_module, judge_output, dispute_finding, report_loop, preview_upload · Public sink: audit_source, scan_source, judge_output, report_loop, preview_upload · Destructive: estimate_audit, list_modules, run_module, judge_output

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
